summary.text: John Corbett, a Republican, has represented Georgia House District 174 since being sworn in on January 12, 2015, and chairs the House Motor Vehicles Committee.

paragraphs.text: His official biography says he is a lifelong resident of Echols County and a graduate of Echols County High School, Valdosta Technical College and Valdosta State University.
According to that biography, he worked for 17 years as an electrician at a paper mill in Clyattville, then joined his brothers at Corbett Electric and Construction, and is also a timber farmer.
